user_roles_scope_check.name: user_roles_scope_check
user_roles_scope_check.value: ("user_roles"."scope"='global' AND "user_roles"."warehouse_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_roles"."scope"='warehouse' AND "user_roles"."warehouse_id" IS NOT NULL)

integration_accounts_fields.name: integration_accounts_fields
integration_accounts_fields.value: "integration_accounts"."provider" IN ('amazon','rakuten') AND "integration_accounts"."account_ref" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,100}$' AND length("integration_accounts"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "integration_accounts"."status" IN ('active','inactive') AND "integration_accounts"."version">0

locations_fields.name: locations_fields
locations_fields.value: "locations"."code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]{0,63}$' AND length("locations"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "locations"."status" IN ('active','inactive') AND "locations"."version">0 AND ("locations"."parent_id" IS NULL OR "locations"."parent_id"<>"locations"."id")

products_names.name: products_names
products_names.value: length("products"."name_ja") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND ("products"."name_ko" IS NULL OR length("products"."name_ko") BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("products"."name_en" IS NULL OR length("products"."name_en") BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("products"."description" IS NULL OR length("products"."description") <= 2000)

sku_mappings_fields.name: sku_mappings_fields
sku_mappings_fields.value: "sku_mappings"."provider" IN ('amazon','rakuten') AND "sku_mappings"."marketplace"='JP' AND length("sku_mappings"."external_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "sku_mappings"."external_code" ~ '^[!-~]+$' AND "sku_mappings"."status" IN ('active','inactive') AND "sku_mappings"."trust" IN ('unverified','local_reviewed') AND "sku_mappings"."version">0 AND (("sku_mappings"."status"='active' AND "sku_mappings"."valid_to" IS NULL) OR ("sku_mappings"."status"='inactive' AND "sku_mappings"."valid_to" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("sku_mappings"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "sku_mappings"."valid_to">="sku_mappings"."valid_from")

sku_mappings_review.name: sku_mappings_review
sku_mappings_review.value: ("sku_mappings"."trust"='unverified' AND "sku_mappings"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "sku_mappings"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "sku_mappings"."evidence_source" IS NULL AND "sku_mappings"."evidence_version" IS NULL) OR ("sku_mappings"."trust"='local_reviewed' AND "sku_mappings"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "sku_mappings"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sku_mappings"."evidence_source"='local_manual' AND "sku_mappings"."evidence_version"<="sku_mappings"."version" AND "sku_mappings"."evidence_version">0)

warehouses_fields.name: warehouses_fields
warehouses_fields.value: length("warehouses"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND ("warehouses"."adapter_config_ref" IS NULL OR "warehouses"."adapter_config_ref" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,100}$')
